BETA Close X Associated British Foods plc has announced the purchase of 34,492 of its ordinary shares for cancellation on April 29, 2026, at an average price of GBp 1829.87 per share, with the highest price paid being GBp 1831.00 and the lowest GBp 1827.00. This transaction was conducted with Barclays Capital Securities Limited as part of the company's ongoing share repurchase program, details of which were previously announced on February 25, 2026. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares.
